question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (4).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrect spelling is **‘Inadvartent’.**
 
• The **CORRECT **spelling is ‘**INADVERTENT**’. It means **(अनजाने में**) - Not resulting from or achieved through deliberate planning.
 
 
• **Example: **The **inadvertent **omission of a comma changed the entire meaning of the sentence. 
 
 

*Therefore, the correct answer is ‘Inadvartent’.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Irresponsible : (अज़िम्मेदार)** - Not showing a proper sense of responsibility.

 
 
• **Example: **Leaving a little boy alone at home is an irresponsible act.
 
 
 
• **Capacious : (विशाल)** - Having a lot of space; roomy.
 
 
• **Example: **The new house has a capacious kitchen suitable for family gatherings.
 
 
 
• **Ravishing : (मनोहारी)** - Delightful; entrancing.
 
 
• **Example: **The bride looked ravishing in her wedding gown.
